title: SWU PHINMA’s Dare to Be congress puts creativity in the hands of Cebu’s next generation
summary: Southwestern University PHINMA’s School of Design + Communication (sd+c) gathered Senior High School students, creatives, and industry professionals for the Cebu Creative and Communication Congress…

blocks.text: Southwestern University PHINMA’s School of Design + Communication (sd+c) gathered Senior High School students, creatives, and industry professionals for the Cebu Creative and Communication Congress (CCCC) on November 21, 2026, at the Cube Wing Atrium of SM Seaside City Cebu. Anchored on the theme “Dare to Be”, the congress challenged the idea that creativity belongs only to people in artistic professions, encouraging participants to see it as a skill they can develop through curiosity, experimentation, and the courage to try.. Creativity is something everyone can develop For Ria Therese Repunte, Executive Director of SWU’s sd+c, creativity should not be limited to […]...
